ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity mottled region located on the distal half of the right lobe; sparse, fine-grained high-intensity streaks and punctate spots on the distal tip of the left lobe; central region and proximal margins are primarily low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 92 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; two distinct deep notches (approx. 15-20 pixel depth) visible on the mid-section of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, exhibiting an upward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, diagonal high-contrast linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible on the dark pigmented area of the left lobe, proximal to the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged loss of tissue along the trailing edge of the right lobe and prominent calcified biological growth (barnacles) on distal tips.
